parts.stem:
Semi-conservative replication of DNA occurs during interphase, before mitosis begins.

Write the correct term in the spaces provided to complete each of statements A to D.
parts.text:
A The DNA double helix unwinds and is separated into two template strands when __________ are broken.

B One of the template strands of DNA is copied in fragments. The enzyme __________ __________ to form a continuous strand of DNA.

C Complementary DNA nucleotides are added to the template strands, catalysed by the enzyme __________.

D __________ are sequences at the ends of chromosomes that allow the continued replication of DNA, without the loss of genes.
